_comment: Change-controlled bake seed manifest for the bf16 baked image (#13). The seed staged to R2 (deploy/stage_bake_seed.py) and the worker's runtime model set are derived from ONE source of truth -- models.py specs + harness/models_mirror keep-set -- so 'baked == what the worker loads, no more'. A second hand-maintained list would drift; that drift (in spirit) is how the :0.3.0 empty bake happened. Revisions are the HF snapshot SHAs pinned in r2:vivijure/models. Sizes are approximate (post-recast for recast repos). The drop-set is recorded with a reason each so this file is the auditable record of BOTH sides.

keep_repos.note: Wan2.2 i2v experts; stored fp32 (~117.5 GiB), recast to bf16 (the precision from_pretrained(torch_dtype=bfloat16) loads at). Largest fp32 shard 4.98 GiB -> ~2.49 GiB bf16, well under the 10 GB GHCR layer limit.

SDXL keyframe base. Loaded via from_pretrained(torch_dtype=bfloat16) with NO variant= arg, so it reads the non-variant fp32 files (incl unet shard 00001-of-00002 at 9.99 GiB). Recast non-variant fp32 -> bf16: halves the 9.99 GiB shard (which would NOT fit a 9 GB bin) and matches the runtime load precision exactly. The .fp16 variant files are kept untouched (not loaded, harmless).

LoRA collection (NOT a diffusers from_pretrained repo), so file-level trim is safe. The spec pins the 4-step Seko-V1 i2v LoRA; keep BOTH the high_noise + low_noise pair. The repo's other ~37 GiB (T2V variants, a 28.5 GiB single file, other step counts) is never loaded -> dropped.
Hyper-SDXL few-step distill LoRA (spec weight_name Hyper-SDXL-8steps-lora.safetensors). Small repo, kept whole.
InstantID identity model repo (ip-adapter.bin + ControlNet). Kept whole (diffusers/HF structure).

IP-Adapter identity. Multi-variant repo kept WHOLE (robust): from_pretrained reads a subfolder; trimming risks dropping a needed config (the #4 class). Disk is free per Conrad; VRAM still loads only the used variant.
SDXL openpose ControlNet (loaded via ControlNetModel.from_pretrained torch_dtype=bfloat16). Already <10 GB max file; kept whole.

finish_dirs.note: InstantID insightface antelopev2 pack (read directly from VJ_MODELS_ROOT/antelopev2).

facexlib detection_Resnet50_Final.pth + parsing_parsenet.pth for GFPGAN/CodeFormer face restore; read offline from VJ_MODELS_ROOT/facexlib via _ensure_facexlib_offline. Closes the finish-leg github fetch the sm_120 de-risk surfaced. sha256 pins are the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH (this object): the staging upload, the build-time bake gate, and the de-risk runtime probe all assert against these exact bytes. Both pins are independently corroborated -- the github release asset and the gmk123/GFPGAN HF mirror serve byte-identical content.

drop_repos.reason: not in the model spec; dead weight (DEFAULT_SKIP_REPOS). ~57.6 GiB saved.
